selected_concern: goal-driver.ts has 5 bare-literal task.status === "needs-human" comparisons that never import the existing canonical vocabulary module (task-status.ts) that 16 other consumers already migrated to.
selected_slice: Investigate the raw dispersion=5 reading before touching anything: github-client.ts's hit is already explicitly exempted by a prior task (a provider package that structurally cannot statically import abi.ts, pinned by its own needle test); observation.ts and workflow-baseline-metrics.ts's hits are false positives (they compare a different vocabulary — a promotion-outcome 'action' field and a workflow 'outcome' field — not task.status). Only goal-driver.ts's 5 of its 6 'needs-human' literal occurrences are genuine, un-migrated task.status comparisons (the 6th, at a different line, compares a GOAL-AC status field, a different vocabulary, and is explicitly excluded). Convert exactly those 5 to consume the existing task-status.ts's isTaskStatus/TASK_STATUS.NEEDS_HUMAN, touching nothing else on the same line (e.g. a line also comparing 'todo'/'ready' leaves those two literals untouched).
why_now: Direct continuation of GOAL-030's validated small-real-goal-branch method, chosen as a second, independent, and smaller/safer sample (a pure text-literal substitution, a different SHAPE of change than GOAL-030's new-module-plus-two-call-sites) specifically to get a second data point on whether the goal-branch mechanism itself generalizes.
why_not_others: The originally planned canonical source was assumed to be a new kernel/task-transition.ts TASK_STATUSES type — but that module only exists on the still-unmerged goal/GOAL-030 branch at this point in history, and depending on a sibling branch's unmerged artifact would create hidden cross-goal-branch coupling. The investigation corrected the premise mid-flight: the real, already-'done'-status canonical source is the pre-existing abi.ts + task-status.ts pair, not a new kernel module. The original numeric target (dispersion <= 2) was also corrected: the achievable floor is 4 (1 canonical declaration + 1 exempted provider + 2 confirmed false positives), not 2 — the original target didn't account for the canonical declaration itself always carrying the literal, and the two false-positive files never being affected by this change.
risk: If the investigation's false-positive/exemption classification is wrong, the 'fixed' count will not actually reach the corrected target, or will silently break the exempted provider's own needle test.

non_goals: do not touch any bare 'todo'/'ready'/'done' literals, even on the same line as a needs-human literal
do not create a second kernel-level declaration of the vocabulary; do not depend on anything that exists only on the unmerged goal/GOAL-030 branch; do not wait for GOAL-030 to merge
do not touch the packages/quay/src directory-cycle issue
do not introduce a shared Verdict primitive
do not touch the separate parseSemanticSufficiencyVerdict/parseFidelityVerdict duplication
stop_signals: same structural signals as GOAL-030 (code-identity falsified, production contamination, isolation failure)
ANY dependency or interference with the goal/GOAL-030 branch (a new red line specific to this goal, since two real pilots are now running concurrently)
need to add a layers.yml edge

acceptance_evidence: Three ACs (AC-343..345), three-state exit codes. The core mechanical judgment is a literal re-count: grep -c 'status === "needs-human"' plugin/scripts/goal-driver.ts must go from 6 to exactly 1 (only the excluded GOAL-AC-status line remains), and get_literal_dispersion(value:"needs-human") must go from 5 to exactly 4, with each of the 4 remaining hits individually justified in the task record (not just asserted as a round number).
stop_abandon_condition: Same abandon discipline as GOAL-030, plus: any detected coupling to or interference with the concurrently-running goal/GOAL-030 branch immediately halts scope expansion.

granularity_rationale.why_not_broader: Could have also converged the two false-positive files' underlying vocabulary confusion, or touched the same-line todo/ready/done literals, but neither recurs the needs-human mechanism specifically and would blur what this slice is actually measuring.
granularity_rationale.why_not_finer: All 5 literal occurrences are the identical mechanical substitution in the same file; splitting per-occurrence would multiply branch-lifecycle overhead (same coordination-cost reasoning as GOAL-030's why_not_finer) for a change that is not independently separable -- a reviewer cannot meaningfully accept 1 of 5 identical-shape edits before the others.
harnessable_subproblems: literal grep-count before/after (a pre-existing, mechanical grep convention)
investigation_required_subproblems: classifying each of the 5 raw dispersion hits as genuine / exempted / false-positive -- required reading each file's actual comparison target, not just counting string matches; this is exactly where the original numeric target (<=2) was discovered to be wrong
primitives_reused: the existing canonical vocabulary module (already landed by a prior task) -- reused, not reinvented
the branch self-host identity check pattern introduced in GOAL-030, scaled down since this goal's own dependency risk differs

timeline.note: The human's own origin line records that the original technical premise was wrong and was corrected BEFORE activation. That correction is the T1 content.

expected_concerns: dispersed literal for one status value across modules, canonical home unclear
possible duplicated/parallel vocabulary declarations between the packages tree and the plugin tree

stage_b_reference.investigate_or_goal_rationale: At T1 every hit is classified and the achievable target is corrected, so the slice is fully specified; the remaining work is a mechanical substitution.
stage_b_reference.minimum_sufficiency_rationale: All 5 genuine occurrences are the identical mechanical substitution in one file, and the correct canonical source already exists and is already used by 16 consumers. Splitting per-occurrence multiplies branch-lifecycle overhead for a change no reviewer can accept piecemeal; broadening to the false-positive files or to unrelated literals would touch things that are not defects.

Only goal-driver.ts's 5 of its 6 'needs-human' literal occurrences are genuine, un-migrated task.status comparisons (the 6th, at a different line, compares a GOAL-AC status field, a different vocabulary, and is explicitly excluded). Introduce a shared Verdict/Status primitive instead of consuming the existing module (rejected: that is a second declaration, not convergence).

Touch the false-positive files or the exempted provider
